title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: Mr. Lionel Mortimer was a young gentleman of few intentions and no

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: private means. Good-humored, by no means ill-looking, and with engaging

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: manners, he was the type of man of whom one would have prophesied great

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: things. His natural gaiety and address were more than enough to carry

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: him over the early stages of acquaintanceship, but subsequent meetings

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: were doomed to end in disillusion. His cheerful outlook on life would be

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: as much to your taste as ever; but the want of a definite aim and an

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: obvious inability to convert his talents into cash made you shake your

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: head doubtfully. A charming fellow, of course, but unpractical ... the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: kind of man who is popular with all but match-making mothers.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: He lived in two rooms in an obscure street off the Strand, and at the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: time when we make his acquaintance he has just finished a meal that

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: stamps the lower middle classes and the impecunious--to wit, high tea.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: For the benefit of gastronomers it may be stated that it included

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: herrings, a loaf of bread, some butter of repellent aspect, and

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: strawberry jam. Lionel has lighted his pipe and seated himself at the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: window to enjoy as much of a June evening as can be enjoyable in a

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: London back street. He has not emitted three puffs of smoke before a tap

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: at the door heralds the entrance of his landlady.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: Mrs. Barker, a woman of commanding presence and dressed in rusty black,

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: came into the room. She did not utter a word, not even the conventional

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: remark that it was a fine night or that the evenings would soon begin to

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: draw in now. With a funereal but businesslike demeanor she began to

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: remove the debris of the meal, at intervals giving vent to a rasping

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: cough or a malignant sniff. Of her presence Lionel seemed oblivious, for

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: he continued sitting with his back to the door, gazing with apparent

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: interest into the street. This, perhaps, was curious, for the street was

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: but a lane with little traffic and no features worthy of note. Nor was

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: the building opposite calculated to inspire the most sedulous observer,

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: being merely the blank wall of a warehouse. Not a single window relieved

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: the monotony, usually so painful to the artist or the adventurer. And

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: yet Lionel puffed at his pipe, gazing silently in front of him as if at

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: a masterpiece by Whistler.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: When the landlady had transferred the tea-things to a tray, shaken the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: crumbs from the table-cloth into the empty grate and folded it, she

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: nerved herself for a direct attack. Placing her arms akimbo--an attitude

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: usually denoting truculent defiance or a pleasurable sense of

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: injustice--she pronounced her lodger's name. Lionel started, as if made

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: aware of her presence for the first time. He took his pipe from his

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: mouth and turned with a pleasant smile.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Good evening, Mrs. Barker," he said with careful politeness. "A fine

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: night, is it not?"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: She assented with an ill grace. Without giving her time to add to her

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: appreciation, Lionel continued in suave but enthusiastic tones:

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Oblige me, Mrs. Barker, by observing the manner in which the sun

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: strikes the opposite wall. Notice the sharp outline of that chimney-pot

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: against the sky. Remark the bold sweep of that piece of spouting--a true

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: secession curve of which the molder was probably completely ignorant.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: Again, the background! That dull gray monotone----"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: This rhapsody was interrupted by Mrs. Barker, whose artistic education

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: had consisted in a course of free-hand drawing in a board school and a

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: study of the colored plates issued by the Christmas magazines. It was

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: hardly to be expected that she should wax enthusiastic over the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: warehouse wall.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "It's no good torkin, Mr. Mortimer," she said; "I want my rent."

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "But how reasonable!" returned Lionel with increased brightness. "How

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: much does it come to? Certain tokens of copper--silver--gold--with some

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: trifling additions for food, fire, etc.----"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "One pahnd three sempence for this week," snapped Mrs. Barker. After a

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: pause she added constrainedly, "If yer please."

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Why! you are even more reasonable than I expected," cried Lionel. "If I

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: please! How could a man refuse anything after so polite a prelude? If I

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: please! My rent, if I please, is one pound, three and sevenpence; and I

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: must admit that the sum is paltry. If I please to exist (and up to the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: present I have been delighted to fall in with the schemes of Providence)

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: I can do so for some twenty-four shillings a week. It includes," he

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: added hopefully, "the washing?"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: She nodded grimly and stretched out her hand. Lionel, with an easy

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: smile, waved her to the door.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "To-morrow, Mrs. Barker, if you please. At the moment I regret to say

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: that my funds do not amount to the necessary sum. To-morrow I make no

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: doubt that----"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: Mrs. Barker interrupted with brisk invective. It appeared that Lionel

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: was several weeks already in arrears. She, it seemed, was a lone widow,

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: earning her bread by the sweat of her brow, and she would not be put

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: upon. The position had become intolerable: either he must pay his rent

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: or leave the next morning.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Let us consider the state of affairs," said Lionel, unruffled. "You, it

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: appears, need your money--or rather, my money--and I can not gainsay the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: moral claim. You have attended to my simple wants in a manner beyond

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: praise, and I would cheerfully pay you your weight in gold (after the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: pleasing custom in the East) had I the precious ore. But at the moment

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: my capital"--he searched his pockets--"amounts to sixpence ha'penny;

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: hence the deplorable _impasse_. My profession holds out no prospect of

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: immediate or adequate reward: briefs are lacking and editors slow to

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: recognize merit. I have pawned such of my wardrobe as is not necessary

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: to support the illusion of an independent gentleman. What do you suggest

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: as a solution of our difficulties? It is repugnant to both of us that I

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: should live on your charity. I am open to any bright idea."

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: Unluckily the landlady was not an imaginative woman. She could suggest

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: nothing, save that Lionel should pay his rent or leave. The method of

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: raising money was left entirely to him, but the necessity was insisted

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: on in forcible terms.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "An ultimatum?" said the lodger thoughtfully. "Well, I can not blame

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: you. As you have no illuminating schemes, Mrs. Barker, I must rely on

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: myself. But rest assured that you shall be paid. What! I am young and

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: strong; my clothes, thanks to judicious mending and a light hand with

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: the brush, will pass muster; we are in London, the richest city in the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: world. I will go out and look for a fairy godmother."

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: At this resolve Mrs. Barker broke into cries of protest. With a feminine

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: distrust of her own sex she declared that no such creature should pass

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: her threshold. For fifty years she had lived respectable, and it was her

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: firm intention to die in the same persuasion. Lionel raised a

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: deprecating hand.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "You mistake me," he said in gentle reproof. "It was but a manner of

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: speaking inspired by the recollection of Cinderella. Being, however,

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: the masculine equivalent of that lady of romance (or shall we say, 'Lob

text: Lie-by-the-Fire'?) and out of deference to your sense of propriety, I

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: will strive to acquire a fairy godfather. Till to-morrow, then, Mrs.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: Barker."

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: and table-cloth, left the room in dudgeon.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: THE HISTORY OF HENRY BROWN

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: Mr. Henry Brown was a man of forty, an age that is supposed to be the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: prime of life, though most of us would prefer to be ten years younger.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: At forty one has shed most illusions, but at least there is the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: consolation of having arrived at a workable philosophy. For some of us

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: this philosophy may mean simple acquiescence; for others an attitude of

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: pleased contemplation, like a yokel smoking his pipe, leaning on the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: gate of a summer evening. Those of us who are married and without the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: philosophy of our own are fortunate in having one--if not

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: several--provided by a wife. And her philosophy, grounded on practical

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: common sense rather than a study of the metaphysicians, is of much more

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: value to the world than abstract thought. She is, in short, better

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: adapted for keeping us up to the mark.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: Henry Brown was unlucky enough to be a bachelor. This was through no

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: fault of his own, for as a young man he had dreamed his dreams of a snug

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: little home, a cheerful wife, and chubby children, who were always to

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: remain at an age not exceeding nine. His dreams, with their usual

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: perversity, had not been realized, though on more than one occasion he

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: had made efforts to find his ideal. There had been, for instance, the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: daughter of a chimney-sweep, a virtuous and charming creature. There had

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: been a policeman's niece, whose boast it was that she could "slip the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: bracelets"--her own expression--on a refractory subject as quickly as a

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: professional thief-taker. There had been the relict of a fish-and-chips

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: salesman, and quite a number of others, equally alluring and

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: disappointing. In his early youth he had dallied with them all, but he

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: had never got beyond the dallying stage.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: The reason had been always the same. It was not that he had failed to

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: find the ideal: not at all! The quarry of the moment had always seemed

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: the most peerless of her sex--with a mental reservation giving the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: policeman's niece the pride of place. It was simply because he could not

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: afford to marry. Girls would "walk out" with him with pleasure. They

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: would give him every encouragement until ... until the fatal truth

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: became known. It was not that his immediate supply of cash was pitiable:

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: it was because he had no "prospects." He had no trade, being merely the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: driver of a cab. Now it is possible for a cab-driver to marry and bring

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: up a family, but it was a perverse fate that all the girls to whom he

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: paid attention looked somewhat higher in life. And Henry Brown was

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: unable to satisfy their aspirations. He was deep in the groove of

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: cab-driving by the time he was twenty-three, and could conceive no other

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: calling at which he might succeed.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: Of course he might have tried to win a wife with less social ambition,

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: but he made only one effort in this direction. At twenty-five he

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: fluttered after a lady who seemed a promising helpmeet. She was a

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: milliner's assistant, and swore to wait till Henry Brown had saved

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: enough to start a home. She waited six weeks, and then, in a fit of

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: romance or madness, married a scavenger.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: This, in a commercial sense, had been the making of Henry Brown. Soured

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: by his experiences, he had resolved to hold aloof from Woman and devote

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: himself to Thrift. Some men might have taken to drink; but a strain of

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: Scottish or Jewish blood, coupled with a human desire to show the world

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: he could do something, compelled Mr. Brown to save. For something like

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: thirteen years he lived carefully and put money by. Then came a chance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: legacy of five hundred pounds. With this and his savings he determined

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: to hazard all, cease to be a wage-slave, and start in business as a

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: He had the luck to start just as taxicabs came in, so he had no old

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: stock left on his hands. He bought two taxis at first and learned the

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: and get experience. Gradually he extended his operations, and by the end

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: he rubbed his hands. "Well," he said to himself one day, "I've done it.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

text: Mr. Brown went about the business with a methodical earnestness, buying

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: Business, which naturally had tended to harden him, had left,

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance

text: "Ah! I am ashamed to tell you that. One day perhaps I shall ... not

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: now."

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "I kissed her, you know," he said frankly. She sat up.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "When?"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "In London, the first night."

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Not since?"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Never."

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: She sat down again.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "A proof of humanity," she smiled. "She's quite charming, I know. Is

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: that all?"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Not yet. Wasn't it very hard to keep up the two roles?"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Hard, but, not so very hard to a woman who has brains and is an

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: actress. It was interesting, and I enjoyed watching you."

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Tell me; suppose I had kissed Miss Arkwright. Would you have forgiven

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: me?"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: The answer came quickly.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Yes. But I'm so glad you didn't!"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "I, too," he confessed. And then, "I think that's all."

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: There was a complete silence for half a minute, while he struggled to

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: find words to say to this most lovely woman. He could find none. Each

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: knew the other's heart already, and words seemed vain and meaningless.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Oh, Beatrice darling!" he said, almost with a sob, "don't keep me

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: waiting any longer! I want you! I want you!"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Lal, dearest!" she said.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "And this is the end," she said presently with a little sigh. "We shall

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: just get married and settle into stodgy conventional people. It sounds

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: flat, doesn't it?"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Why should it be the end? We can be happy and ourselves, too. We can

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: still have romance, adventures, though youth passes----"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: She shook her head.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "No; we shall have happiness, but never the same as this. We have been

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: lucky and had the most splendid fun. But now, whether we wish it or not,

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: we shall have to grow up and try to find out what life is."

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Well, we'll bargain for one adventure a year, at least," he stipulated.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Old or young, we'll have that!"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "We must earn it, Lal!" she said with a wise smile. "We've no right to

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: such happiness unless----"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Make me your debtor now!" he said, clasping her more closely.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Beatrice, darling, I love you! Do you realize it? I love you!"

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: She breathed one word, the most perfect pledge a man could hope for.

title: The Gay Adventure: A Romance
text: "Egotist!"

text: THE END
